WidgetHome.title: See it in action: try it yourself
WidgetHome.description: This demo runs on a sample wine shop, not on your catalog, so the wines, prices and interface language are not yours. Describe a meal or an occasion and see how the sommelier answers.

HowItWorks.title: How it works
HowItWorks.lead: Shoppers describe what they want in their own words and get four wines from your catalog, each with a short reason.
HowItWorks.step1Text: Send your wine list as a CSV or product feed, or connect the API. It takes less than a day.
HowItWorks.step2Text: Our team configures Wineater on your inventory within 24 hours.
HowItWorks.step3Text: A QR code, a widget or an API link. You choose how shoppers reach it.
HowItWorks.qrDesc: Print it and place it at tables or near the wine shelves. Customers scan it, with no app to download.
HowItWorks.widgetDesc: One script tag on your wine pages. It matches your store's branding and recommends only from your catalog.
HowItWorks.apiDesc: Connect Wineater to your own search or recommendation engine. Full white-label, with inventory kept in sync.
HowItWorks.trialTitle: Try it with your real catalog
HowItWorks.trialDesc: 30-day pilot, no credit card and no commitment. Share your wine list, we set everything up, and you see what it does for your business.

Footer.text: Stop losing wine sales to indecision
Footer.trial: 1-month free trial · No credit card required
Footer.closing: Ready to see your catalog in Wineater?

ForWhom.title: Shoppers want wine. They don't know which bottle.
